text: The present moment is the only moment available to us, and it is the door to all moments.
The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
You have no power over outcomes, only over your own reasoned choice.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms — to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
source: Viktor Frankl, Man's Search for Meaning

text: Those who have a 'why' to live can bear almost any 'how.'
source: Viktor Frankl, Man's Search for Meaning

text: In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities; in the expert's mind there are few.
source: Shunryu Suzuki, Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind

text: All that we are is the result of what we have thought. The mind is everything.
Drop by drop is the water pot filled. Likewise, the wise one, gathering it little by little, fills oneself with good.
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom. Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life.
Sow a thought, reap an action; sow an action, reap a habit; sow a habit, reap a character; sow a character, reap a destiny.
Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
Envy is ignorance; imitation is suicide.
The invariable mark of wisdom is to see the miraculous in the common.
The cure for boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
We are all leaves of one tree. We are all waves of one sea.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
The way to do is to be.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
Do not seek to have events happen as you wish, but wish them to happen as they do happen, and your life will go smoothly.
Your children need your presence more than your presents.
There is no such thing as a perfect parent. So just be a real one.
Children are not a distraction from more important work. They are the most important work.
The way we talk to our children becomes their inner voice.
Children have never been very good at listening to their elders, but they have never failed to imitate them.
Children need love, especially when they do not deserve it.
The greatest gift you can give children is the roots of responsibility and the wings of independence.
A person's a person, no matter how small.
source: Dr. Seuss, Horton Hears a Who!

text: When children feel understood, their loneliness and hurt diminish. When they feel understood, they feel free to give up their defenses and show their better selves.
source: Haim G. Ginott, Between Parent and Child

text: Children thrive when they know their parents delight in who they are and believe in their capacity to grow.
You don't have to be perfect to be a perfect parent.
One of the greatest things a father can do for his children is to love their mother.
Children will not remember you for the material things you provided but for the feeling that you cherished them.
Home is the place where, when you have to go there, they have to take you in.
source: Robert Frost, The Death of the Hired Man

text: It's not our job to toughen our children up to face a cruel and heartless world. It's our job to raise children who will make the world a little less cruel and heartless.
What you leave in your children matters more than what you leave for them.
Look for the helpers. You will always find people who are helping.
You've made this day a special day, by just your being you. There's no person in the whole world like you; and I like you just the way you are.
Play is the work of childhood.
The days are long but the years are short.
Children need at least one adult in their life who is irrationally enthusiastic about them.
Children are apt to live up to what you believe of them.
The most important thing a parent can teach a child is how to get along without them.
Every word, facial expression, gesture, or action on the part of a parent gives the child some message about self-worth.
The secret of parenting is not in what you do but in who you are when you are with your child.
